_meta.name: Seasonal influenza vaccination, ≥65 years, NHIS
_meta.source: National Health Interview Survey (NHIS), Health, United States Table 068
_meta.note: NHIS percentage aged 65 years or older reporting influenza vaccination in the past 12 months, assigned to survey calendar year; this HUS table run ends in 2016. The NHIS past-12-months self-report by calendar year and the FluVaxView season estimate are a paired comparison of two different instruments and must not be spliced into one series.
